```{r setup}
# Run code from the project root so targets can find its data store
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "..")
```

```{r load}
library(targets)
config     <- tar_read(config)
ws         <- sf::st_read(tar_read(watershed_final), quiet = TRUE)
streams    <- sf::st_read(tar_read(streams_final), quiet = TRUE)
dem        <- terra::rast(tar_read(dem_harmonized))
soils      <- terra::rast(tar_read(soils_harmonized)[1:3])
mapunits   <- read.csv(tar_read(soils_harmonized)[4])
precip     <- terra::rast(tar_read(precip_harmonized))
precip_raw <- tar_read(precip_files)   # raw zips; the PFDS point table is saved alongside
forest     <- terra::rast(tar_read(forest_harmonized))
dist       <- terra::rast(tar_read(dist_harmonized)[1:5])   # 6th file is the code lookup
dist_codes <- read.csv(tar_read(dist_harmonized)[6])
catalog    <- read.csv(tar_read(layer_catalog))
dictionary <- read.csv(tar_read(data_dictionary))

# Color palettes: one per kind of variable
pal_elev <- hcl.colors(50, "Terrain")
pal_k    <- hcl.colors(50, "YlOrBr", rev = TRUE)
pal_pct  <- hcl.colors(50, "Grays", rev = TRUE)
pal_prec <- hcl.colors(50, "Blues", rev = TRUE)
pal_for  <- hcl.colors(12, "Greens", rev = TRUE)
pal_year <- hcl.colors(12, "YlOrRd", rev = TRUE)   # later years darker
pal_cnt  <- hcl.colors(8, "Purples", rev = TRUE)
pal_sev  <- c("grey75", "khaki", "orange", "red3")  # 0 none, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high

# Shared scale for both K maps, so equal colors mean equal values
k_range <- range(as.vector(terra::global(soils[[1:2]], c("min", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)))
```

## Study area

```{r study-area, results = "asis"}
cat(paste0(
  "**Watershed:** ", ws$watershed_name, " (HUC12 ", ws$huc12, ")  \n",
  "**Area:** ", round(ws$area_km2, 1), " km²  \n",
  "**Output CRS:** EPSG:", config$crs, "  \n",
  "**Grid resolution:** ", config$resolution_m, " m"
))
```

## Terrain and streams

```{r map-dem, fig.cap = "Harmonized DEM with stream network (blue) and watershed boundary (red)."}
terra::plot(dem, col = pal_elev, main = "Elevation (m)")
terra::lines(terra::vect(streams), col = "blue")
terra::lines(terra::vect(ws), col = "red", lwd = 2)
```

```{r map-order, fig.cap = "Stream network by Strahler stream order. Darker and thicker lines are higher-order (larger) streams."}
ord  <- sort(unique(streams$stream_order))
cols <- hcl.colors(length(ord) + 1, "Blues 3", rev = TRUE)[-1]   # skip the palest blue
plot(sf::st_geometry(ws), border = "grey40", main = "Stream order")
plot(sf::st_geometry(streams), add = TRUE,
     col = cols[match(streams$stream_order, ord)],
     lwd = 0.5 + streams$stream_order)
legend("bottomleft", legend = ord, col = cols, lwd = 0.5 + ord,
       title = "Strahler order", bty = "n")
```

## Soils

K-factors are aggregated from SSURGO components and horizons (see the decision log). Both K maps share one color scale. Soil values are uniform within each map unit polygon, so their real spatial detail is the polygon, not the 10 m grid.

```{r map-kw, fig.cap = "Whole-soil K-factor (kwfact), which accounts for rock fragments."}
terra::plot(soils[["soil_kw"]], range = k_range, col = pal_k,
            main = "K whole soil (kwfact)")
```

```{r map-kf, fig.cap = "Fine-earth K-factor (kffact), which excludes rock fragments. Same color scale as the whole-soil map."}
terra::plot(soils[["soil_kf"]], range = k_range, col = pal_k,
            main = "K fine earth (kffact)")
```

```{r map-nok, fig.cap = "Percent of each map unit made up of components without a K-factor (rock outcrop, rubble land, pits, water)."}
terra::plot(soils[["soil_pct_no_k"]], col = pal_pct,
            main = "Percent of map unit without K (rock, rubble)")
```

## Precipitation

Rainfall intensity for the `r config$precip$ari_years`-year storm from NOAA Atlas 14 Volume 12 (partial duration series), converted from depth to intensity and resampled from about 800 m to the 10 m grid. Each map has its own color scale; intensity varies only a few percent across the watershed, so the smooth gradients show a small range.

```{r map-precip, fig.cap = "Rainfall intensity (mm/hr) by storm duration."}
for (i in seq_len(terra::nlyr(precip))) {
  terra::plot(precip[[i]], col = pal_prec,
              main = paste0(names(precip)[i], " (mm/hr)"))
}
```

## Forest structure

Canopy cover and canopy height from LANDFIRE 2024, resampled from 30 m to the 10 m grid with nearest neighbor. LANDFIRE stores both as classes, so each map shows a small set of values, each representing a range.

```{r map-forest-cc, fig.cap = "Forest canopy cover (%), LANDFIRE 2024 classes."}
terra::plot(forest[["forest_cc"]], col = pal_for, main = "Canopy cover (%)")
```

```{r map-forest-ch, fig.cap = "Forest canopy height (m), LANDFIRE 2024 classes."}
terra::plot(forest[["forest_ch"]], col = pal_for, main = "Canopy height (m)")
```

## Disturbance history

LANDFIRE Annual Disturbance, `r config$disturbance$start_year` to `r config$disturbance$end_year`. Each year's codes are translated with that year's LANDFIRE attribute table and grouped by type (`2_protocol/dist_type_groups.csv`). Year maps show the most recent year of each disturbance group; blank areas had no disturbance of that group. LANDFIRE may under-record insect mortality, which develops gradually; see the decision log. LANDFIRE's own disturbance type and severity labels, with the group and severity class assigned to each, are listed in 4_product/data/disturbance_codes_`r config$study_area$huc12`.csv.

```{r map-dist-years, fig.cap = "Most recent year of harvest, fire, and insect or disease disturbance."}
for (nm in c("dist_last_harvest_year", "dist_last_fire_year", "dist_last_insect_year")) {
  if (all(is.na(terra::global(dist[[nm]], "max", na.rm = TRUE)))) {
    terra::plot(terra::vect(ws), main = paste(nm, "(none recorded)"))
  } else {
    terra::plot(dist[[nm]], col = pal_year, main = nm)
    terra::lines(terra::vect(ws), col = "grey40")
  }
}
```

```{r map-dist-count, fig.cap = "Number of years with any recorded disturbance."}
terra::plot(dist[["dist_count"]], col = pal_cnt, main = "Years with any disturbance")
```

```{r map-dist-sev, fig.cap = "Severity class of the most recent disturbance (0 no severity class, 1 low, 2 medium or moderate, 3 high)."}
# Fixed value-to-color table, so each class keeps its color even when some
# classes are absent from the watershed
sev <- dist[["dist_last_severity"]]
levels(sev) <- data.frame(value = 0:3,
                          severity = c("None", "Low", "Moderate", "High"))
terra::coltab(sev) <- data.frame(value = 0:3, col = pal_sev)
terra::plot(sev, main = "Severity of most recent disturbance")
terra::lines(terra::vect(ws), col = "grey40")
```

## Quality checks

```{r qa}
res <- config$resolution_m

# Share of DEM cells inside the watershed that are missing
inside  <- terra::rasterize(terra::vect(ws), dem)
n_in    <- terra::global(inside, "notNA")[[1]]
n_na_in <- n_in - terra::global(terra::mask(dem, inside), "notNA")[[1]]

# Soil coverage inside the watershed
kw_in     <- terra::mask(soils[["soil_kw"]], inside)
pct_in    <- terra::mask(soils[["soil_pct_no_k"]], inside)
# no map unit, or a map unit with no components: a real gap in the soil data
n_nodata  <- n_in - terra::global(pct_in, "notNA")[[1]]
# K missing even though the map unit has some soil: should never happen
n_k_gap   <- terra::global(is.na(kw_in) & pct_in < 100, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]
# map units that are entirely rock, rubble, pits, or water: describes the landscape
n_nonsoil <- terra::global(pct_in == 100, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]

dem_rng <- as.numeric(terra::global(dem, c("min", "max"), na.rm = TRUE))
str_rng <- range(c(streams$elev_min_m, streams$elev_max_m), na.rm = TRUE)
k_rng   <- range(as.vector(terra::global(soils[[1:2]], c("min", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)))

crs_codes <- c(sf::st_crs(ws)$epsg, sf::st_crs(streams)$epsg,
               as.numeric(terra::crs(dem, describe = TRUE)$code),
               as.numeric(terra::crs(soils, describe = TRUE)$code),
               as.numeric(terra::crs(precip, describe = TRUE)$code),
               as.numeric(terra::crs(forest, describe = TRUE)$code),
               as.numeric(terra::crs(dist, describe = TRUE)$code))

# Disturbance: years within the requested range, counts and severity plausible
yr_cfg   <- c(config$disturbance$start_year, config$disturbance$end_year)
yr_layers <- c("dist_last_harvest_year", "dist_last_fire_year", "dist_last_insect_year")
yr_rng   <- range(unlist(lapply(yr_layers, function(nm)
              as.numeric(terra::global(dist[[nm]], c("min", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)))), na.rm = TRUE)
cnt_max  <- terra::global(dist[["dist_count"]], "max", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]
n_years  <- diff(yr_cfg) + 1
sev_vals <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(terra::values(dist[["dist_last_severity"]]))))
# Disturbance types not in dist_type_groups.csv (counted as "other")
unmapped <- sort(unique(dist_codes$dist_type[!dist_codes$in_groups_file]))

# Forest: classed values survive resampling only if no blending happened
n_classes <- vapply(names(forest), function(nm)
  length(unique(stats::na.omit(terra::values(forest[[nm]])))), integer(1))

# Precipitation: compare the watershed-center value with NOAA's point table
pf_lines <- readLines(file.path("1_input", "source_metadata", "precip",
                                paste0("pfds_point_intensity_", config$study_area$huc12, ".txt")))
ari_cols <- trimws(strsplit(sub("^.*:,", "", grep("^by duration", pf_lines, value = TRUE)), ",")[[1]])
col_i    <- match(as.character(config$precip$ari_years), ari_cols)
dur_lab  <- c("30m" = "30-min", "60m" = "60-min", "06h" = "6-hr")
noaa_pt  <- vapply(unlist(config$precip$durations), function(d) {
  line <- grep(paste0("^", dur_lab[[d]], ":"), pf_lines, value = TRUE)
  as.numeric(trimws(strsplit(sub("^.*:,", "", line), ",")[[1]])[col_i])
}, numeric(1))
ctr      <- terra::vect(sf::st_centroid(sf::st_geometry(ws)))
grid_pt  <- as.numeric(terra::extract(precip, ctr)[1, -1])
pt_diff  <- abs(grid_pt - noaa_pt)

# Shorter storms should be more intense than longer ones in every cell
p_order  <- all(vapply(seq_len(terra::nlyr(precip) - 1), function(i) {
  d <- terra::global(precip[[i]] - precip[[i + 1]], "min", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]
  d > 0
}, logical(1)))

checks <- data.frame(
  check = c(
    "All layers use the output CRS",
    "DEM cell size matches config",
    "DEM grid snapped to cell size",
    "Soil rasters on the same grid as the DEM",
    "No missing DEM cells inside watershed",
    "DEM elevations within the range of the lower 48 states (-100 to 4500 m)",
    "All streams fall within the watershed",
    "Stream elevations within 50 m of DEM range",
    "K-factors in SSURGO range (0.02 to 0.69)",
    "No cells inside the watershed without soil data",
    "Whole-soil K missing only where the map unit is entirely rock, rubble, pits, or water",
    "Share of watershed that is entirely rock, rubble, pits, or water (information)",
    "Precipitation rasters on the same grid as the DEM",
    "Precipitation at watershed center within 1 mm/hr of NOAA point table",
    "Shorter storms more intense than longer storms in every cell",
    "Forest rasters on the same grid as the DEM",
    "Forest values are LANDFIRE classes, not blended (20 or fewer distinct values per layer)",
    "Disturbance rasters on the same grid as the DEM",
    "Disturbance years within the requested range",
    "Disturbance count no greater than the number of years requested",
    "Disturbance severity values are 0, 1, 2, or 3",
    "All LANDFIRE disturbance types are in dist_type_groups.csv"
  ),
  result = c(
    paste(unique(crs_codes), collapse = ", "),
    paste(terra::res(dem), collapse = " x "),
    paste("xmin", terra::xmin(dem), "/ ymin", terra::ymin(dem)),
    as.character(terra::compareGeom(dem, soils, stopOnError = FALSE)),
    paste0(n_na_in, " of ", n_in, " cells"),
    paste(round(dem_rng, 1), collapse = " to "),
    paste(sum(lengths(sf::st_within(streams, sf::st_buffer(ws, 1))) > 0), "of", nrow(streams)),
    paste0("streams ", paste(round(str_rng, 1), collapse = " to "),
           "; DEM ", paste(round(dem_rng, 1), collapse = " to ")),
    paste(round(k_rng, 3), collapse = " to "),
    paste0(n_nodata, " of ", n_in, " cells"),
    paste0(n_k_gap, " cells with missing K in map units that have soil"),
    paste0(n_nonsoil, " of ", n_in, " cells (", round(100 * n_nonsoil / n_in, 2), "%)"),
    as.character(terra::compareGeom(dem, precip, stopOnError = FALSE)),
    paste0("grid ", paste(round(grid_pt, 2), collapse = ", "),
           "; NOAA ", paste(noaa_pt, collapse = ", "), " (mm/hr)"),
    as.character(p_order),
    as.character(terra::compareGeom(dem, forest, stopOnError = FALSE)),
    paste0(names(n_classes), ": ", n_classes, " values", collapse = "; "),
    as.character(terra::compareGeom(dem, dist, stopOnError = FALSE)),
    paste0(paste(yr_rng, collapse = " to "), " (requested ", paste(yr_cfg, collapse = " to "), ")"),
    paste0("max ", cnt_max, " of ", n_years, " years"),
    paste(sev_vals, collapse = ", "),
    if (length(unmapped) == 0) "all mapped" else
      paste("counted as other:", paste(unmapped, collapse = ", "))
  ),
  pass = c(
    all(crs_codes == config$crs),
    all(terra::res(dem) == res),
    terra::xmin(dem) %% res == 0 && terra::ymin(dem) %% res == 0,
    terra::compareGeom(dem, soils, stopOnError = FALSE),
    n_na_in == 0,
    dem_rng[1] > -100 && dem_rng[2] < 4500,
    all(lengths(sf::st_within(streams, sf::st_buffer(ws, 1))) > 0),
    str_rng[1] > dem_rng[1] - 50 && str_rng[2] < dem_rng[2] + 50,
    k_rng[1] >= 0.02 - 1e-6 && k_rng[2] <= 0.69 + 1e-6,   # tolerance for stored precision
    n_nodata == 0,
    n_k_gap == 0,
    NA,                                                     # information only
    terra::compareGeom(dem, precip, stopOnError = FALSE),
    all(pt_diff < 1),
    p_order,
    terra::compareGeom(dem, forest, stopOnError = FALSE),
    all(n_classes <= 20),
    terra::compareGeom(dem, dist, stopOnError = FALSE),
    all(is.finite(yr_rng)) && yr_rng[1] >= yr_cfg[1] && yr_rng[2] <= yr_cfg[2],
    cnt_max <= n_years,
    all(sev_vals %in% 0:3),
    length(unmapped) == 0
  )
)
checks$pass <- ifelse(is.na(checks$pass), "INFO", ifelse(checks$pass, "PASS", "CHECK"))
knitr::kable(checks, col.names = c("Check", "Result", "Status"))
```

Checks marked CHECK are not necessarily errors; see the decision log for known differences (for example, stream attributes describe whole flowlines, not the clipped segments). Rows marked INFO describe the watershed rather than test the data.
